lore: Nobody in the city agrees on what AnyaBear is. Pitbull, says one Line; lab, says another; rot, says a third. Everyone agrees on the paw prints: they turn up in wet cement, fresh, on streets that were poured years ago. AnyaBear has no card and is never played. She is only ever seen in the afterglow.
